Title: TOM: need circle ruling + jyhad question

Messages.Author: patrick michael hancy
Messages.Body:

PMH

Messages.Author: Brian Cash
Messages.Body:
patrick michael hancy (hancy@cis.ohio-state.edu) wrote:


: Tom, 
:   Can a COP prevent damage from spells like earthquake and hurricane ?
:   How about damage from pestilence ?

Why ask Tom? This one is easy. 
CoPs prevent damage from any one SOURCE.
Enchantment, artifact, creature, instant, lawsuit, whatever.
If damage comes from it (and "it" is the correct color), you may
use CoP to protect yourself. Easy, yes?

:   Are there any deck construction limits for Jyhad ?

Only on the size of the decks.  It's in the rules.

There are no restricted Jyhad cards.

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
patrick michael hancy <hancy@cis.ohio-state.edu> wrote:
>  Can a COP prevent damage from spells like earthquake and hurricane ?
>  How about damage from pestilence ?

Circles don't care why you're taking damage, just what color it is.
Yes, they can be powered up against damage done by a non-targetted effect.

>  Are there any deck construction limits for Jyhad ?

The only limits in the rulebook are the minimum of 40, and the maximum
of 40 + (10 * no. of players).  No Convocation Jyhad rules have
been released.
